headline: Executive order titled "Ending Birth Tourism" targets travel to the US for the purpose of giving birth here.
what_it_does: This order was signed by President Trump on August 6, 2026. Based on its title, it aims to stop "birth tourism," which usually means traveling to the United States to give birth so the child can get US citizenship. No summary was provided, so the specific rules, agencies involved, and enforcement steps are not known from this source.

who_it_affects.group: Pregnant foreign visitors seeking to enter the United States
who_it_affects.how: The order's title suggests it may limit their ability to travel to the US to give birth, though the specific measures are not described.
